{{Quote|Why did you summon me? I took Tatooine -- It was ''my'' conquest. Now another is sent to reap the slaves?!|[[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]], to Predor [[Skal'nas]]|<ref name="Force Storm 1" />}}
The '''Conquest of Tatooine''' was an event in which [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]&mdash;[[25,793 BBY|then]] a lush world&mdash;was subjugated by the [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] and the forces of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. A [[Unidentified Tatooine city|city]] was [[Fire/Legends|burned]], and many [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] were purged or taken prisoner after the battle.<ref name="Force Storm 1" />
